title: Material Blend 2-Mix Trio #22 (대각 띠 4구역·매끈 / 동심원 4구역·물결 / 가로 띠 4구역·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, two thick goddess braids — her body carries 2 different materials repeated across 4 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 diagonal bands by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 36% of the way down her figure from the top, about 52% of the way down her figure from the top and about 70% of the way down her figure from the top. The regions alternate between 2 materials in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID DEEP BLACK scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET and VIVID CYAN panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries the same material as Region 1. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries the same material as Region 2. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.
